name: Figma MCP Server
what: Brings design context from your Figma files into AI coding tools so they can generate code that matches your designs. The remote server can also write to the canvas (in beta), creating and editing content in your Figma files.
who: Designers and frontend devs turning Figma frames into real UI.

setup.text: Add the remote server to a supported client (Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex and others). Cursor config:

setup.code: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp

setup.text: Sign in through Figma's OAuth flow.
Copy a link to a frame or layer in Figma and paste it into your prompt.
Writing to the canvas is in beta and needs edit access to the file. Test on a duplicate file first.

prompts: Implement this Figma frame as a React component with Tailwind: <link>
List the colors and text styles used in this design.
Compare my current page with this Figma frame and fix differences.
